EmailTemplate.name: WG Forgot Password
EmailTemplate.subject: Reset your Wadhwani Grants password
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Receiving_User.FirstName},
Someone asked to reset the password for your Wadhwani Grants account.
This email is about the account below:
Account email: {!Receiving_User.Email} Link expires: 24 hours after the request
If that was you, use the link below to choose a new password. The link expires in 24 hours.
Set a new password: {!Community_Url}
If that was not you, please reply to this email.
Wadhwani Grants will never ask you for your password or a one-time code, by email or by phone. If any message does, do not reply to it and do not open its links. Send your queries by email to grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.
Kind Regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
-- Wadhwani Grants, the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation. Questions? Just reply to this email; it reaches the Wadhwani Grants team at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.
